title: rehearse --decide runs the shape check; bounds.out is a hard edge
intention: rehearsal.decide refuses a writes_to path that bounds.out names, widens bounds.in by name for a path in neither list, and refuses a plan on which the cast door's shape check finds a lack it did not find before.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: 96c1c2ea5ce9 and f695fac922cd took writes outside bounds.in at decide commits afa3a151/149d6c28 and f00cddf1, and decide never ran transitions._shape_lacks. Orchestrator 2026-11-16: 'The bounds' out list is a hard edge ("out is out"). So decide refuses outright a write to a path in bounds.out; no widening. Only a path in neither list may widen bounds.in, and the decision line names it as a widening. Keep both small.'
traces_to: Law 4: decide was a door into the plan that skipped the cast door's check.
how: _bounds_widened raises Refused on a bounds.out write and returns the paths in neither list. Those are added to bounds.in and named in the line's text as '(widens bounds.in: ...)'. _shape before and after: any new lack raises Refused, with nothing written. The backfill widens 96c1 and f695 through cairn artifact write --verb cast, plus one bounds_widened log line each.

clauses.claim: in cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_a_decision_stays_inside_its_bounds.py, a decision writing a path bounds.out names is refused naming it ('out is out'), and the ticket is byte-identical

in cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_a_decision_stays_inside_its_bounds.py, a decision writing a path in neither list lands with bounds.in gaining it and the line's text ending '(widens bounds.in: <path>)'; a write inside bounds.in widens nothing

in cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_a_decision_stays_inside_its_bounds.py, a decision whose reads resolves to no file is refused through the shape check with the ticket byte-identical, while a lack the ticket already carried does not stop a clean decision
